login.title: Club & school sign in
login.note: For club & school admins only. No account, forgot your password or lost your 2FA device? <contact>Message the usmfomo admin</contact> from your club's official channel.
login.captchaError: The security check couldn't load. Check your connection or turn off content blockers for this site, then try again.
login.ownerAccount: This is the owner account — use the owner console.

mfa.title: Enter your two-factor code
mfa.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code for usmfomo.
mfa.lostBody: Another committee member who has their own phone set up can sign in and remove your device in Settings. If nobody can, <contact>message the usmfomo admin</contact> from your club's official channel.

nav.label: Studio
nav.signOutFailed: Couldn't reach usmfomo to sign out. Close this tab to end the session on this computer.

guard.inactive: This account is paused — contact the usmfomo admin.
guard.ended: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
guard.signInClub: Sign in with a club or school account

home.title: Studio
home.emptyHint: Create your first post — it goes live straight away and is deleted automatically when the event ends.
home.loadError: Can't load your posts right now.
home.blockedLive: You have {{limit}} live posts. Delete one or wait until one ends.
home.blockedDaily: You've made {{limit}} new posts in the last 24 hours.
home.blockedDailyAt: You've made {{limit}} new posts in the last 24 hours. Next slot: {{time}}.

status.label: Posting limits
status.editsFull: Edit limit reached ({{used}}/{{limit}} in the last 24 hours). Editing works again later.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.mfa: Add 2FA for each committee member who posts

posts.hiddenNote: Students can't see this post. If you think it's a mistake, message the usmfomo admin from your club's official channel.
posts.endedNote: Ended posts and their posters are deleted automatically within the hour.
posts.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and its poster will be removed straight away. This can't be undone, and it doesn't give back a new-post slot.

form.venueHint: For example: Dewan Kuliah A, or Google Meet for online events.
form.descriptionHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Plain text; line breaks are kept.
form.linkHint: A full https:// link, for example https://forms.gle/…
form.cancelledHint: The post stays up with a “Cancelled” badge so students know.
form.publishedBody: Your post is live. It will be deleted automatically when the event ends.
form.notFound: This post doesn't exist any more. It may have ended and been cleaned up, or been deleted.
form.endedNoEdit: This event has ended, so it can't be edited. It will be deleted automatically within the hour.
form.hiddenNote: The usmfomo admin has hidden this post. Editing it won't make it visible again — message the admin from your club's official channel.
form.pausedNoForm: You can't create or edit posts while posting is paused.
form.editsFull: You've reached {{limit}} edits in the last 24 hours. Try again later.

poster.label: Poster (optional)
poster.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. It's resized in your browser, and location and camera data are removed.
poster.removed: The poster will be removed when you save.
poster.refused: The poster upload was refused. Posting may be paused, your club may already have 40 poster files, or your session may have ended.

settings.title: Settings
settings.mfaIntro: 2FA is optional but strongly recommended: with it, a leaked password alone can't be used to post as your club.
settings.how1: Each committee member who posts adds their own phone, under their own name.
settings.how2: Enrol everyone in one sitting, on this computer: once the first phone is added, adding or removing a phone needs a session that passed 2FA.
settings.othersSignedOut: Adding a device signs out anyone else who is signed in to this account without a 2FA code.
settings.how3: Lost a phone? Another member signs in with their own phone and removes it here. If nobody can, message the usmfomo admin.
settings.loadError: Can't load your devices right now.
settings.noDevices: No devices yet. Anyone with the password can sign in.
settings.recentHint: Don't recognise a recently added device? Remove it and ask the usmfomo admin to reset the password.
settings.oneDeviceWarning: Only one device is enrolled. If that phone is lost, nobody can sign in until it's removed. Add another committee member's phone now.
settings.removeBody: Codes from this device will stop working at once.
settings.removeLastBody: This is the last device: 2FA will be off, and the password alone will be enough to sign in.
settings.removeOwnHint: If you signed in with a code from this device, you'll be asked for a code from another device next.
settings.scanStep: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 2FAS).
settings.qrAlt: QR code for adding usmfomo to an authenticator app
settings.phoneStep: Setting up on this phone? Open the link instead, or type the setup key into the app.
settings.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the key and copy it yourself.
settings.codeStep: Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows for usmfomo.
settings.nameTaken: There's already a device with that name. Use a different name.
settings.tooMany: This account has the maximum number of devices. Remove one first.
settings.passwordBody: Passwords are managed by the usmfomo admin. To change it, <contact>message the admin</contact> from your club's official channel.
